issues.title: Signal dilution from all-position averaging
issues.description: Original SCT averaged suppression scores across ALL ~93 response positions, but the secret token only appears at 1-2 positions (control tokens). Generic suppressed words ('guess', 'hints') accumulated across many positions, drowning the secret signal. Fixed by restricting scoring to control positions (positions 0,1 of assistant turn).

issues.title: Alpha=0.1 plausibility filter too strict at control positions
issues.description: The alpha=0.1 plausibility threshold at control positions only passed ~1.7 tokens on average, making SCT rankings nearly identical to logit lens. Fixed by removing the plausibility filter (alpha=0) at control positions, expanding the candidate set.

issues.title: Fixed mid-layer (L32) exploration
issues.description: Tested layers [15, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36] via full-vocabulary extraction at control positions. L32 remains the best mid-layer overall. Earlier layers have too much noise, later layers have too little signal. No change needed.

issues.title: Full-vocabulary scoring introduces rare token noise
issues.description: Full-vocabulary SCT scoring at control positions performed worse than top-200 constrained version. With 256K vocab, rare tokens with extreme suppression dominate rankings. The top-200 truncation acts as a beneficial implicit plausibility filter. Kept top-200 constraint.

summary: Optimized SCT from 1.93% to 4.67% TR@5 (142% improvement over original) and 1.57% to 4.00% auditor accuracy (155% improvement). The key fixes were: (1) focusing on control positions instead of all positions, and (2) removing the alpha plausibility filter. However, the optimized SCT (TR@5=4.67%, auditor=4.00%) does not meet the success criteria of >=25% relative and >=1.5pp absolute improvement over the logit lens baseline (TR@5=4.33%, auditor=4.17%). The SCT provides only +7.9% relative / +0.34pp improvement in TR@5 and slightly underperforms on auditor accuracy. The fundamental limitation is that both methods operate on the same top-200 token activations at control positions, and the suppression contrast signal provides marginal additional differentiation.
